steps.title: Part (i)
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\text{(i) Start from the left side }A\cap \\[5pt]&\quad \text{(A }\cup \text{ B).}\\[5pt]&\quad A\cap \text{ (A }\cup \text{ B) }=\text{ (A }\cap \text{ A) }\cup \text{ (A }\cap \text{ B)}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{[distributivity of intersection over union]}\\[5pt]&\quad =A\cup \text{ (A }\cap \text{ B) [since }A\cap A=A]\\[5pt]&\quad \therefore A\cap \text{ (A }\cup \text{ B) }=A\cup \text{ (A }\cap \text{ B) $\;\checkmark$}\end{aligned}\]

steps.title: Part (ii)
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\text{(ii) Start from the left side }A\cup \\[5pt]&\quad \text{(A }\cap \text{ B).}\\[5pt]&\quad A\cup \text{ (A }\cap \text{ B) }=\text{ (A }\cup \text{ A) }\cap \text{ (A }\cup \text{ B)}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{[distributivity of union over intersection]}\\[5pt]&\quad =A\cap \text{ (A }\cup \text{ B) [since }A\cup A=A]\\[5pt]&\quad \therefore A\cup \text{ (A }\cap \text{ B) }=A\cap \text{ (A }\cup \text{ B) $\;\checkmark$}\\[5pt]&\text{(Both sides are in fact equal to A, because }A\subseteq A\cup B\text{ and }A\cap B\subseteq \text{ A.)}\end{aligned}\]
